papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract: A benchmark evaluating vision-language models as judges of computer-using agent trajectories. Reveals systematic leniency bias in state-of-the-art models and introduces OS-Shepherd open reward models for cost-effective evaluation.

papers.title: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
papers.abstract: Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from magnetoencephalographic recordings by deep networks. This work redesigns spatial attention using spherical harmonics and reveals which speech properties drive retrieval through occlusion analysis.

papers.title: From Economic Agents to Agentic Economies: A Systems Blueprint for Economic World Models
papers.abstract: Develops an implementation roadmap for economic world models that simulate heterogeneous agents interacting through markets and institutions. Organizes systems into capability levels from fixed rule-based agents to evolved institutional worlds.

papers.title: DataSpace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Verifiable Analytics over Heterogeneous Workspaces
papers.abstract: A benchmark containing 410 cross-language tasks across 7,439 artifacts for evaluating data agents producing verifiable results from heterogeneous workspaces. Best accuracy reaches 66.34% across frontier multimodal models.

papers.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
papers.abstract: End-to-end adaptation of Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek including corpus mining and synthetic supervision. Introduces HERA benchmark and achieves nDCG@10 improvement from 0.362 to 0.835.

papers.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
papers.abstract: Compiles passively captured screen activity into agent memory deterministically without models, reducing daily capture to prompt-ready context 86x smaller. Demonstrates agent reading achieves 98.4% accuracy on questions.

papers.title: KVAE: Family of Tokenizers for Multimodal Generative Models
papers.abstract: Presents tokenizers for audio, image and video designed for text-conditioned generation. Reconstruction and generation results match or surpass frontier open-source tokenizers from Wan-2.2, HunyuanVideo, FLUX.2.

papers.title: EffectLearner: World-Aware Object-Effect Reasoning for Real-World Video Object Removal
papers.abstract: Framework combining VLM-based object-effect reasoning with DiT-based video eraser for comprehensive object-effect removal. Constructs EffectWorld dataset for complex real-world scenarios and introduces progressive training curriculum.

papers.title: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
papers.abstract: First open-source 8B-parameter language model for Yiddish with Oytser pretraining corpus and Kashes benchmark. Demonstrates that language-specific models better capture lexical and morphological patterns than multilingual alternatives.

papers.title: Continual Learning in Transition
papers.abstract: Survey examining continual learning evolution through three dimensions: When, How, and Where learning occurs. Traces transition from parameter-centric learning toward system-level adaptation with external components.

cc_updates.body: Added gateway spend-limit support to Claude Code's usage warning; the limit-reached message now names the cap, its reset time, and the operator's message (requires the gateway on 2.1.225). Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`. Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart. Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors after a keychain read timed out. Fixed auto mode counting a safety-filter refusal toward the consecutive-block limit. Fixed cross-session messages staying parked without notice or expiry in headless sessions. Fixed conversation history breaking on Remote Control session resume after very large conversations were compacted.

Added self-hosted environments: `claude self-hosted-runner` turns your own machines or containers into a place Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions can run, on Team and Enterprise plans. Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning. Added a cancel-and-confirm step when removing an unavailable paste changes a command's text. Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile. Added `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry` settings for cross-session messages. Added sandbox credential-masking options including JWT-aware masking and AWS SigV4 re-signing. Added cross-session `SendMessage`: Claude Code sessions can message each other on any machine with `ListAgents` to discover them (macOS and Linux).
